newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic sees gains in gross margins.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic sees gains in gross margins.

text.p: Medtronic Inc chief financial officer Robert Ryan said moderate improvement in gross profit margin can be expected if prices hold in the medical device giant's key markets.
He said gross margin today is about 74 percent.
"If pricing holds, you could expect moderate improvement," Ryan said in an interview Tuesday at the company's headquarters.
Prices are holding steady or improving in the key pacemaker, implantable defibrillator, stent and other markets, Ryan said.
"The only place where prices are eroding is in balloon angioplasty," he said.
